ana: Quick huddle — we want a staggered X + LinkedIn push for mid-April feature launch. Needs: final copy, 30s demo + 16:9 hero, and HubSpot intake. Who can own the form/webhook?
jon: I can own scheduling and employee seed. Two copy tracks: A = Quick wins (snappy), B = Benchmarks (data). Suggest X=A, LinkedIn=B. Seed 30m before org post.
lucy: Video update: finishing color & captions. Will export ~29s MP4 (burned captions) and 1:1 crop. Uploading to Drive /marketing/launch/assets and s3://redwood-marketing/launch/.
raj: I'll build HubSpot form + workflow. Fields: name,email,company,role,use_case,consent. Hidden fields: utm_source=social, utm_campaign=april_feature_launch. Webhook -> https://hooks.internal/crm/hs-launch-apr. Assign to SDR queue and tag 'april_social'.
ana: (accidental) — don't include.
jon: Schedule plan: employee seed 8:45am PT, org X 9:15am PT, LinkedIn 9:25am PT. Follow-up retarget at +7h if CTR < 3%; if engagement >400, trigger Wave2 with case study CTA.
